title: Poe's Interrogation
description: About to be captured by the First Order, Resistance pilot Poe Dameron entrusted valuable information passed on to him by Lor San Tekka to his Astromech Droid, BB-8, who promptly escaped into the desert. Dameron attempted to take down First Order commander Kylo Ren following San Tekka's execution, but was quickly captured. Soon after, Poe was subjected to an intense interrogation aboard Kylo Ren's Star Destroyer, the Finalizer.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #2 of 20
